Name: Tortilla Press
Author: oclarina
Description:
The tortilla press unlocks at farming level 1, and it takes 2 iron bars and 50 wood to craft it. Each time you put an item through the tortilla press, it adds 10g to the sell price. The tortilla press accepts most items as inputs, and requires 1 corn as "fuel."

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]By design, the tortilla press accepts flavored tortillas as input, however this could result in Infinite Tortilla Recursion, so I wouldn't recommend using it with Automate.
[*]This mod will auto-detect if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37258]Recentered Tortillas[/url]﻿ and automatically center the flavored tortillas as well.
[*]No extra content with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37260]Overcompensating Tortilla[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37274]Inspect Tortilla[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37275]Confused Tortillas[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37285]Celebrity Tortilla[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37291]Tortilla Spouse Portraits[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37298]Tortillanimos[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34984]Tortilla Mask[/url]﻿, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37299]Pierre REALLY Hates Tortillas[/url]﻿. But like, nothing will break, so you should download them all anyways. Enter the tortillaverse.
[/list]
